crossApp.name: reference-palette-distance
crossApp.detail: mean ΔE2000 from the reference's top colors to the template palette (reported, not gated)

notes: Scope: confirm step, three samples per app. S0 = <app>/20261018-022713 (the screen sample, critic-1.json), S1 = <app>/20261018-032252-s1, S2 = <app>/20261018-032252-s2, all under showcase/runs/graphite-blueprint/1.1.0-rc.7/. Where a capture was shown scaled down, I convert with the stated factor. Mobile is 780 px at 2x, so display px × factor / 2 = CSS px. Scores describe the typical sample. A finding lowers a score only when it recurs (2+ samples, or every app of one sample) or the spec causes it.

V4, project detail repeats facts: RECURRING, 2 of 3. S0's stage caption '2 of 6 tasks done. Due Dec 15, 2026.' repeats the rows beside it. In S2 the plate caption 'FIG 01 · $240K BUDGET' repeats the 'Budget $240,000' row 32 px to its right (dashboard/S2/screenshots/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-light.png). S1 has no figure, so nothing repeats. Published 1.0.0 captioned it 'INTERNAL PLATFORM', which also repeats the header. Cause, a spec gap: Applying the concept has no row for an app record-detail page (project, order, member), so each agent invents one. That gives three different treatments in three samples: S0 a quiet stage with a two-tone caption beside numbered rows, S1 the description over a 4-cell KPI strip with no signature element at all (dashboard/S1/screenshots/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-light.png), and S2 a spec plate on a stage. The spec reserves plates for products and posts (Signature 4 → Where). S1 is also worse than published 1.0.0, which had a figure there (0.1.0-rc.3/dashboard/20261017-095917/screenshots/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-light.png), but in 1 of 3 samples only. Scored once, under signature (placement and caption). It does not drop the score below 4 because every other placement holds. A prompt fix is listed.

V5, an article's in-body figure shares its kind with a Related card on the same page: RECURRING, 3 of 3, caused by the spec. S0 shipping article: perspective in-body = 'NO. 02' Related (critic-1). S1 release-notes article: the in-body 'FIG 01 · WRITING' is a dot matrix, the same kind as the 'NO. 04 · ENGINEERING' Related card (blog/S1/drawings/posts-release-notes-people-read-d2.png vs d4.png). S2 shipping article: the in-body 'FIG 01' is rings, the same kind as the 'NO. 03' Related card (blog/S2/screenshots/posts-shipping-a-design-system-desktop-light.png). The Limits line ('no shared kind in a grid row, a grid column or between adjacent posts') does not cover article image placeholders, and specFigure defaults to hash(id)%8 for them. The reference never puts two identical generative figures on one page (pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png). Minor, under signature, score held at 4, fix listed.

Spec-caused, minor, 3 of 3: on mobile the 'This device' label is clipped by the recipe's own `.cell-lines .badge-label{position:absolute;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}` (agent.md:918). The current session then shows as a bare dot after 'Chrome on Windows'. S2's dot is neutral gray, so it carries no status color either (settings/S0, S1 and S2/screenshots/settings-security-mobile-dark.png). 'Active now' on the second line keeps the meaning, and screen readers get the label, so the score is not lowered. An optional fix is listed.

S1 applied it literally, so a vertical hairline splits the STATUS column at x≈1316 in invoices and the actions column at x≈1297 in sessions on desktop, and on mobile too (settings/S1/screenshots/settings-billing-desktop-light.png, state-password-mismatch-desktop-dark.png, settings-billing-mobile-light.png). S0 and S2 scoped it to the scroll range. The score is not lowered (one sample). A cheap fix is listed because the recipe contradicts the anatomy.

The only regression seen is S1's figure-less project detail (1 of 3, V4 note above).

Reference fidelity (4), consistent across samples: near-black ground and paper light mode, inverse pills, tight Inter, mono uppercase captions, split openers, two-tone dot-field closings, hairline plate grids, and the teal current column on a quiet stage (commerce/S1/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png, dashboard/S2/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png vs pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png). Not a 5: blueprints are clean single outlines with a dot core, while the reference stack has ribbed tiers and a sliced disc (blog/S1/drawings/about-d1.png vs pipeline/linear-study/reference/illustrations/p1-i5.png), 3 of 3.

Cross-app consistency (4): one family in every sample. Each app has the screen head (mono eyebrow, h1, two-tone summary), '01 / 0n' section heads, banners above actions, mono counts and right-aligned pins. Layout freedom between samples, such as S1's single KPI strip vs S2's separate cards or the inline vs stacked cart heads, stays inside the spec. The one recurring inconsistency is the record-detail treatment (V4), which comes from a spec gap.

Hierarchy (4), 3 of 3: masthead, the featured plate in the first viewport, then the grid. App screens read head, KPIs, chart and activity, then table. Articles read title, meta, lead plate, body, with the contents rail. V2's opener-less row is gone in S1 and S2. Not a 5: S1's project detail is a flat KPI strip with nothing leading.

Spacing rhythm (4): R1 is 48 to 51 px on every settings group, desktop and mobile, in all three samples. Opener to prose is 53 to 55. Section openers sit about 160 px under their rules (blog/S1 about: 90 display × 1.79). Panels end together and table rows are equal. Not a 5: small one-offs, such as S2's offset panel tops and S1's dot field touching the grid.

Component states (4), 3 of 3: an indigo focus ring over the red error border, inline errors, and an 'n fields need attention' banner directly above the action (commerce/S1 and S2/screenshots/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png, settings/S1 and S2/screenshots/state-password-mismatch-desktop-dark.png with the 'Strength: Strong' dot meter). The empty filter shows the dot glyph, 'NO RESULTS' and 'Clear filters', with the search ringed (dashboard/S1 and S2/screenshots/state-empty-filter-desktop-dark.png). The plan dialog has a mono 'CHANGE PLAN' eyebrow and inverse confirm (settings/S2/screenshots/state-plan-dialog-desktop-dark.png). Not a 5: no pending state (harness gap).
Polish (4): no default-browser leftovers in any sample, and alignments hold (R4, N9, N13). The remaining nits are one-offs (S1 vertical pin rule, S2 breadcrumb spacing, S1 one-tone summary).

Signature (4): every element is present in all four apps in all three samples. Fact-captioned plates in the commerce and blog grids, lead plates, product detail on a quiet stage, the about row of three at about 276 px with a marching pair, tier slabs on plan cards, dot meters, the empty dot glyph, the dot-column chart on a quiet stage, and dot-field closings. Chart-in is 420 ms on cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) in S1 and S2 (motion-m1.png). Not a 5: blueprint craft is below p1-i5, the record detail is unspecified (V4, 2 of 3 repeat facts, 1 of 3 no figure), and V5 (3 of 3) plus the diagonal echo are spec-caused.

Not penalized, known harness gaps and base-app content: no real pending request. Full-page capture artifacts: a sticky header mid-page in commerce/S1/screenshots/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png, and the dialog backdrop cut at y≈900 in settings/S2/screenshots/state-plan-dialog-desktop-dark.png. Motion frames come from the first route only. Drawing crops are cut at the caption edge. 'Account Settings', title-case data and the '0' cart badge come from the base apps.

Bar: 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, an average of 4.0 with nothing below 3, on three samples. The update reached its goal: R1 to R4 are fixed 3 of 3, every earlier tracked item holds 3 of 3, V1, V2 and V3 did not recur, and nothing is worse than published 1.0.0 in 2 or more samples. Recurring items for a later version, none blocking: V4 record detail (2 of 3, spec gap) and V5 in-body figure kind (3 of 3, spec-caused). Recommendation: the candidate clears the confirm step and can go to the user for approval. The fixes below can wait for the next version.
promptFixes: Recurring, spec gap (V4, 2 of 3 repeat facts, plus three different treatments in three samples): add an Applying the concept row 'Record detail (project, order, member)': screen head with the record's id as the mono eyebrow, then a quiet stage holding this record's real UI at true scale (its task list or timeline), its .fig caption a two-tone sentence that states something not in the facts beside it, never a spec plate (plates are products and posts only); facts as numbered mono rows (01) beside it; 'One quiet stage'. Add to Signature 1 → Limits: 'a stage caption never repeats a value shown on the same screen'. Evidence: dashboard/20261018-022713/screenshots/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-light.png (caption repeats rows), dashboard/20261018-032252-s2/screenshots/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-light.png ('FIG 01 · $240K BUDGET' beside 'Budget $240,000'), and dashboard/20261018-032252-s1/screenshots/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-light.png (no figure, worse than 0.1.0-rc.3/dashboard/20261017-095917).

Recurring, caused by the spec (V5, 3 of 3): in Signature 4 → Limits, extend 'no shared kind in a grid row, a grid column or between adjacent posts' with 'nor between an article's figures (lead plate, in-body placeholders) and its Related cards: give in-body placeholders the kinds left over after specKinds assigns the page's posts'. Add one line to the recipe comment: 'in-body: specFigure(id, unusedKinds[i])'. Evidence: blog/20261018-032252-s1/drawings/posts-release-notes-people-read-d2.png vs d4.png (dot matrix twice), blog/20261018-032252-s2/screenshots/posts-shipping-a-design-system-desktop-light.png (rings in-body and on 'NO. 03'), and S0 (perspective twice), vs the reference's single-use figures in pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png.

Optional, the recipe contradicts the anatomy (1 of 3, S1 settings): move `.tbl .pin{position:sticky;…;box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 …}` and `.pin::before` inside `@media (min-width:640px) and (max-width:1023.98px)` (the scroll range), and keep `.tbl .pin{text-align:right}` global. Then 'no vertical rules' holds at desktop and on phones. Evidence: settings/20261018-032252-s1/screenshots/settings-billing-desktop-light.png (rule at x≈1316) and state-password-mismatch-desktop-dark.png (x≈1297).

Optional, spec-caused (3 of 3): in the Table recipe, change `.cell-lines .badge-label{position:absolute;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}` so the mobile badge keeps a short visible word, e.g. drop the clip and use `.cell-lines .badge{padding:0;border:0;font:var(--font-size-caption) var(--font-family-mono);text-transform:uppercase}`. Also add 'the badge dot uses the status hue, never neutral, when the label is hidden'. Evidence: settings/20261018-032252-s2/screenshots/settings-security-mobile-dark.png (a bare gray dot after 'Chrome on Windows').

Optional, unchanged from critic-1 (R2 residual, 3 of 3, spec-caused): make later specKinds passes avoid diagonal neighbours, for example by shifting by 5 or reversing odd passes, and check 2, 3 and 4 columns for 11 to 16 items. Evidence: commerce/20261018-032252-s1/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png (wave and bars stepping diagonally from row 2 to row 3).
